title: Toward planetary microbial systems biology
title_zh: 走向行星微生物系统生物学
abstract: Microorganisms underpin Earth's biosphere, sustaining life, shaping biogeochemical cycles, and maintaining ecosystem stability. In an era of scientific and geopolitical fragmentation, we advocate for a "planetary microbial systems biology" (PMSB) framework to uncover the mechanisms and organizational principles governing Earth's interconnected microbial systems across scales of matter, space, and time and in relation to underlying natural and anthropogenic drivers. PMSB combines molecular and cellular technologies, multi-omics data, artificial intelligence (AI), and integrated transdisciplinary research across ecosystems. By federating open data and combining field observations, experimentation, and modeling, PMSB enables predictive understanding of microbiome dynamics across planetary scales, thus filling a critical knowledge gap in our understanding of the co-evolution of life and the Earth-system.
abstract_zh: 微生物是地球生物圈的基石，维持生命、驱动物质循环并维持生态系统稳定。在科学与地缘政治分裂的时代，我们主张建立“行星微生物系统生物学”(PMSB) 框架，以揭示跨物质、空间和时间尺度以及与自然和人为驱动因素相关的地球相互关联的微生物系统的机制和组织原则。PMSB结合分子和细胞技术、多组学数据、人工智能(AI)以及跨生态系统的整合性跨学科研究。通过联邦开放数据，结合现场观测、实验与建模，PMSB能够在行星尺度上预测微生物群落的动力学，从而填补我们对生命与地球系统共同进化认知中的关键空白。
